hints.title: Reverse Whitespace Trimming
hints.text: The last word appears at the very end of the string once any trailing spaces are skipped. Traversing backwards avoids processing earlier words.

hints.title: Trailing Space Skip Invariant
hints.text: Skipping all trailing whitespace characters from the tail isolates the exact ending index of the terminal word.

hints.title: Backward Scan Counter Procedure
hints.text: Start from the last index of the string and move left while characters are spaces. Once a non-space character is reached, increment a length counter until encountering another space or the beginning of the string. Return the accumulated length.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Splitting the string on spaces creates an array of words in heap memory, taking O(N) space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Scanning backwards from the tail takes O(N) time in the worst case and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should avoid library split operations and implement the backward character traversal.
